name: idle-saver
description: Reclaims VS Code's memory while you are idle. Windows only.

idleSaver.enabled.description: Watch for idleness and reclaim memory automatically.

idleSaver.lightIdleSeconds.description: Seconds of inactivity with the window focused before working sets are trimmed.

idleSaver.unfocusedIdleSeconds.description: Seconds after the window loses focus before working sets are trimmed. Alt-tabbing away is a strong signal, so this is much shorter.

idleSaver.deepIdleSeconds.description: Seconds of inactivity before helper processes are put into efficiency mode.

idleSaver.efficiencyModeOnDeepIdle.description: Apply EcoQoS and idle priority to helper processes at deep idle (Task Manager shows this as Efficiency mode).

idleSaver.restartLanguageServersAfterMin.description: Restart the Dart and TypeScript analysis servers after this many idle minutes to reclaim heap they will never return on their own. 0 disables. Costs a re-index when you come back.

idleSaver.minimumFreeMemoryPercent.description: Only act when free physical memory drops below this percentage. Set to 0 to always act.

idleSaver.extraProcessNames.description: Extra process names to include beyond VS Code's own tree, e.g. dartvm.exe or dartaotruntime.exe when they are not children of this window.
